name: Roger Barel
source:
A member of the Crown, a royal commissioned unit under the direct control of the Queen. Formerly, he was a doctor.

He appears to be a rational man, but he is an egoist who will stop at nothing for the sake of his own research.

He seems to have an ambition that he has not revealed to anyone.

Organisation: Crown
Fairy Tale Curse: Snow White's Hunter

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/villains/original/character/#roger]official website[/url]]
